title: Oversight Board says Meta's rules for AI deepfakes are 'consistently and fundamentally inadequate'
content:
Oversight Board says Meta's rules for AI deepfakes are 'consistently and fundamentally inadequate'
The group has repeatedly criticized the company's handling of AI-generated material.
The Oversight Board is once again pushing Meta to address the flood of AI-generated content on its platform. The group published its two latest decisions dealing with the social media company's handling of AI content. The cases show that Meta's rules are "consistently and fundamentally inadequate to address the rapid rise of AI-generated content on its platforms," the board said in a statement.
Both cases were related to posts with AI-generated videos. One depicted a Scottish politician saying "refugees are welcome here, even if they rape our women, because white people do that too." The video was a "realistic" but synthetic portrayal, according to the Board. And the politician whose voice was replicated said the effect of the video was "quite traumatic."
Meta told the board that it didn't remove the video when it was reported because it hadn't been flagged by any of its "trusted partner" organizations and because it didn't seem to be interfering with voting or other processes. The video was also not labeled as AI-generated, apparently because the person who posted it didn't choose to disclose it was made with AI.
The Oversight Board said that the video should have been removed for breaking Meta's hateful conduct rules, and that it should have been prominently labeled as AI. Following the board's decision, Meta said it would remove the video.
The other case also features an AI-generated video of a real person. The video was based on a TV interview with a volunteer who was promoting menstrual health education. Some time after the initial interview, "accounts across social media platforms digitally manipulated the interview footage to ridicule her" and those videos went viral.
According to the board, Meta automatically closed a report and subsequent appeal about the post, which was never labeled as AI-generated. Meta removed harassing comments on the post for breaking its rules around bullying only after the Oversight Board got involved. In a statement following the board's decision, Meta said it would remove the post.
The group says that both cases highlight how AI content is being used to target people on its platforms and that the lack of consistent labeling is causing additional harm. "From politicians to private citizens, AI-generated deepfakes are increasingly being used to harass and silence women from engaging in public discourse," Oversight Board Co-Chair Pamela San Martin said in a statement. "These cases demonstrate a broader, troubling pattern in which women who engage publicly on issues are disproportionately subjected to harassment and misinformation."
The Oversight Board's criticism is unsurprising. The group, which makes policy recommendations to Meta, has repeatedly criticized the company for its approach to AI content and urged for new rules. The bigger question is whether Meta really cares about the board's perspective on this issue. The company has so far made few changes to its AI labels, which typically consist of a small banner that says "AI Info." The company hasn't agreed to implement many of the board's recommendations on AI labeling in other recent cases.
In its statements in response to the Oversight Board, Meta didn't address its criticism directly. But the company has 60 days to respond to its latest recommendations, including that it prioritize likely AI content for review when it's reported.
Update, September 17, 2026, 1:33PM ET: This post was updated to reflect Meta's responses to the Oversight Board.

report.summary: 监督委员会批Meta深度伪造规则根本不足
report.background: Meta监督委员会是独立审查机构，可对删帖争议裁决并提政策建议，此前多次批评Meta对AI生成内容的处理。此次发布两起AI换脸/合成视频案裁决，涉及政治人物和普通女性被深度伪造。案件暴露Meta依赖外部举报、标签机制失效、审核迟缓。行业背景是生成式AI降低造假门槛，平台面临大选、性别暴力与虚假信息压力。
key_points: 两案均涉AI合成视频：一案伪造苏格兰政客发表煽动性言论，另一案篡改月经健康教育志愿者采访用于羞辱。Meta最初均未删除或未加AI标签。
Meta解释首案未删因未被可信伙伴标记且未干扰投票；未标AI因发布者未主动披露。委员会认为应依仇恨行为规则删除并显著标注。
第二案中Meta自动关闭举报和申诉，直到委员会介入才删除骚扰评论；帖子始终未标注AI生成。Meta事后称将删除两帖。
委员会批评Meta规则“一贯且根本不足”，缺乏一致标签加剧伤害，AI深度伪造正被用于骚扰和噤声女性公共参与。
Meta有60天回应新建议，包括对被举报的可能AI内容优先审核；但此前对AI标签建议采纳有限，AI Info标签改动少。
report.impact: 对AI行业，平台审核和AI内容标识成监管焦点，可能推动更严格披露、水印和问责；对开发者，深度伪造检测、内容溯源、审核API需求上升，但合规成本增加；对普通用户，尤其女性与公众人物，平台若继续滞后将更难防骚扰和虚假信息，也提醒对视频真实性保持警惕。Meta若采纳建议，标签和优先审核或改善体验，否则信任受损。
report.tools: 可关注C2PA/Content Credentials内容溯源标准、Google SynthID水印、Hive/Reality Defender深伪检测、OpenAI等模型的元数据政策，以及Meta的AI Info标签与Oversight Board案例库。开发者可跟进开源deepfake detection项目和平台审核API。
